title: Natural Q&A #7
summary: A personal Q&A in which NH puts the channel in the public domain, then covers why he left France for North America, introversion and loneliness, his mixed politics, his personal Christianity and respect for Islam, music while lifting, acne and gyno, recomping, money and work, and several anime topics. Fitness takeaways: log every session, save hard music for working sets, stop blaming genetics, don't fantasise about TRT, and don't drag a partner to the gym.
claims: The whole channel is public domain; anyone may download, re-upload or repurpose his videos, and he would likely not come back if the channel were deleted
Arm wrestlers know how to build forearms because a failing wrist loses the match; bodybuilders can borrow their arm and forearm techniques
He moved to North America at about 20-21 after his first degree, with €3,000 saved, for a master's on a scholarship
He left France because merit was not rewarded there: as a top student he was sent to bad schools and denied scholarships, while the US offered him money and a 75k scholarship
Mixing bad students into good classes drags the class down, and sending top students to bad schools hurts them
Being dropped alone into a foreign country with no safety net made him grow up faster than anything else
He is extremely introverted, never gets lonely, and keeps only a few close friends who usually pursued him
Lonely introverts should not get stuck in a cycle of isolation: go for walks, talk to people at the gym, take up an activity, reach out to friends and family
He has right-wing, progressive, traditionalist and even communistic views and refuses to buy a party's whole package
He avoids politics on the channel because of a 'political curse': once a channel takes sides it becomes a political channel
He spends about 20 minutes a week on YouTube fitness; the more experienced you get, the less of it you watch, his channel included
He listens to podcasts during warm-ups and watches about 2 hours of YouTube a day
He is a non-practising Catholic who follows only the New Testament, and he sees Jesus as a blend of masculine strength and kindness, not a pushover
Churches were where communities formed; losing them is part of why young people in cities like Paris feel lonely
He studied Islam and considered converting at 16; he admires its ban on intoxicants and escapism but rejects its political control and limits on freedom
He doesn't drink to get drunk, only an occasional glass of red wine, and he rarely eats pork because he doesn't like it
He lived about a year in housing that turned out to be part of a mosque, for $300 a month, while in grad school
Strong, affectionate bonds between men are normal and necessary for growth
He keeps a document of video ideas, has no journal, and logs every gym session because logging is unavoidable
He no longer plays video games; his hobbies are reading and lifting because he prioritises
He wants to be the best version of himself by his own definition, not the best at bodybuilding
Don't listen to music for the whole session, because you blunt its adrenaline boost; use podcasts or language lessons for warm-ups and save hard music for working sets
He never had gyno and had only mild teenage acne
To clear acne, stop harsh face washes, drink water, cut soda, refined sugar, dairy and fast food, and sleep more
True gyno (a swollen gland) needs surgery; fat chest just needs chest training and fat loss
He has no skincare routine and credits whole home-cooked food, vegetables, water and clean air for his skin
He will keep recomping until he stops progressing, which could take 4-5 years, because he still has fat to fuel muscle gain
He sleeps 7 hours; wake when you need to be productive, not at 4-5 am to copy celebrities
He prefers earning money through work rather than investing; work is happiness and health, and two weeks off makes him miserable
If you always second-guess yourself, practise decisiveness with small risks and own your mistakes
He owns close to 1,000 physical manga and supports authors only when the series is good
He dislikes Armin in Attack on Titan for regretting acts he chose; living in line with your values is better
The truly dangerous man with nothing to lose is the principled one who has lost his group, not the amoral man
People who say they can't gain are lying to themselves; blaming genetics or environment is an excuse, the change has to come from within
Don't fantasise about TRT for when you are older (35 years away for him); your body is anabolic now, so grow now
Don't push a partner to train; the drive has to come from within and pushing only puts them off
He likes training in cold, dry weather even though a 20-degree garage is tough
He gave his personal views against taking the COVID vaccine; this is non-fitness opinion
Following any political or religious text to the letter is impossible and unwise
